name: Virginia Championship 2025

venue.name: Henrico Sports & Events Center
venue.address: 1 All Star Boulevard, Glen Allen, VA 23059

information:
This is the Virginia championship, but anyone can compete regardless of their state of residence. See more information on the Championship Eligibility tab.

This event will take place on the arena side of the [Henrico Sports & Events Center](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Qa6Py33k4Pm3DHJL8). Please see the Venue Information tab for information on where to park and what doors to use. Also, please note that outside food and beverage is not permitted.
